description: List the readable exhibits (individual documents with stored text) within an SEC filing, by internal filing ID. Returns each exhibit's `id` (the exhibit id for reading that exhibit's text), exhibit type, description, content size and sec_url. Excludes XML/XBRL and documents with no stored text.

filingId.description: Internal filing ID (numeric), the `id` on filing search rows.

name: get_filing_exhibits
title: Get Filing Exhibits
